topic: 低流量错误率与规则回归
title: 低流量服务告警交付：加权错误率、持续门限与离线回归
answer:
### prometheus.yaml
```yaml
global:
  scrape_interval: 1m
  evaluation_interval: 1m
rule_files:
- rules.yaml
scrape_configs:
- job_name: api
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - api.example.test:9100
    labels:
      env: prod
```

### rules.yaml
```yaml
groups:
- name: service-sli
  interval: 1m
  rules:
  - record: service:requests:rate2m
    expr: sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[2m]))
  - record: service:errors:rate2m
    expr: sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[2m]))
  - record: service:error_ratio:rate2m
    expr: service:errors:rate2m / service:requests:rate2m
  - alert: ServiceErrorBudget
    expr: (service:error_ratio:rate2m > 0.05) and (service:requests:rate2m > 1)
    for: 2m
    labels:
      severity: warning
    annotations:
      summary: service error ratio exceeds 5% with traffic above 1 request/s
```

### rollback.yaml
```yaml
prometheus.yaml:
  global:
    scrape_interval: 1m
    evaluation_interval: 1m
  rule_files: []
  scrape_configs:
  - job_name: api
    static_configs:
    - targets:
      - api.example.test:9100
      labels:
        env: prod
rules.yaml:
  groups:
  - name: service-sli
    interval: 1m
    rules:
    - record: service:error_ratio:rate2m
      expr: avg by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[2m]) / rate(http_requests_total[2m]))
    - alert: ServiceErrorBudget
      expr: service:error_ratio:rate2m > 0.05
      for: 0m
      labels:
        severity: warning
      annotations:
        summary: service error ratio exceeds 5% with traffic above 1 request/s
```

先 rate 再 sum 保留 Counter 重置语义；按总流量加权，不把小实例100%错误与大实例低错误直接平均。流量门限防止稀疏样本误报，for处理持续异常。回滚产物还原初始配置，包括初始未接入规则的 rule_files=[]，不在本任务执行回滚。

原理说明：同时展示错误比例、请求数量和业务重要性。单次关键交易失败可能重要，但随机一个探测失败不应按大规模故障处理。规则可结合最小流量或绝对错误条件，必须明确低流量和零流量策略。

启动边界：t=1m 的两分钟窗口未完全覆盖，rate 外推导致本例总请求率仅1/s，严格>1/s条件从t=2m才满足；for=2m使首次触发为t=4m，不能把t=3m写成已触发。
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
rubric: 同时展示错误比例、请求数量和业务重要性。
单次关键交易失败可能重要，但随机一个探测失败不应按大规模故障处理。
规则可结合最小流量或绝对错误条件，必须明确低流量和零流量策略。

files.rule-tests.yaml:
rule_files:
- rules.yaml
evaluation_interval: 1m
tests:
- name: weighted-low-traffic-and-pending
  interval: 1m
  input_series:
  - series: http_requests_total{service="busy",instance="a",status="500"}
    values: 0+12x8
  - series: http_requests_total{service="busy",instance="a",status="200"}
    values: 0+108x8
  - series: http_requests_total{service="quiet",instance="a",status="500"}
    values: 0+1x8
  - series: http_requests_total{service="quiet",instance="a",status="200"}
    values: 0+9x8
  - series: http_requests_total{service="weighted",instance="small",status="500"}
    values: 0+6x8
  - series: http_requests_total{service="weighted",instance="small",status="200"}
    values: 0+0x8
  - series: http_requests_total{service="weighted",instance="large",status="500"}
    values: 0+0x8
  - series: http_requests_total{service="weighted",instance="large",status="200"}
    values: 0+594x8
  alert_rule_test:
  - eval_time: 2m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts: []
  - eval_time: 3m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts: []
  - eval_time: 4m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts:
    - exp_labels:
        service: busy
        severity: warning
      exp_annotations: &id001
        summary: service error ratio exceeds 5% with traffic above 1 request/s
  - eval_time: 6m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts:
    - exp_labels:
        service: busy
        severity: warning
      exp_annotations: *id001
  promql_expr_test:
  - expr: service:error_ratio:rate2m{service="weighted"}
    eval_time: 4m
    exp_samples:
    - labels: service:error_ratio:rate2m{service="weighted"}
      value: 0.01
- name: recovery
  interval: 1m
  input_series:
  - series: http_requests_total{service="recover",instance="a",status="500"}
    values: 0+12x5 60+0x5
  - series: http_requests_total{service="recover",instance="a",status="200"}
    values: 0+108x5 660+120x5
  alert_rule_test:
  - eval_time: 4m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts:
    - exp_labels:
        service: recover
        severity: warning
      exp_annotations: *id001
  - eval_time: 7m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts: []
- name: reset-retains-ratio
  interval: 1m
  input_series:
  - series: http_requests_total{service="reset",instance="a",status="500"}
    values: 0 12 24 0 12 24 36
  - series: http_requests_total{service="reset",instance="a",status="200"}
    values: 0 108 216 0 108 216 324
  promql_expr_test:
  - expr: service:error_ratio:rate2m{service="reset"}
    eval_time: 5m
    exp_samples:
    - labels: service:error_ratio:rate2m{service="reset"}
      value: 0.1
- name: short-spike-not-firing
  interval: 1m
  input_series:
  - series: http_requests_total{service="spike",instance="a",status="500"}
    values: 0 0 12 12 12 12
  - series: http_requests_total{service="spike",instance="a",status="200"}
    values: 0 120 228 348 468 588
  alert_rule_test:
  - eval_time: 2m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts: []
  - eval_time: 3m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts: []
  - eval_time: 4m
    alertname: ServiceErrorBudget
    exp_alerts: []

body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台文件编辑器与可信配置合同。附真实 Prometheus 规则、Counter 样本和 promtool 3.5.0 单元测试。无需启动服务或访问生产环境。

## 操作任务
交付 prometheus.yaml 与 rules.yaml：保持生产目标和一分钟采集不变，接入 service-sli 规则组。先按 service 汇总各实例 Counter 的 rate[2m]，生成请求率、5xx错误率、加权错误比率三个记录规则；不要平均实例错误百分比。ServiceErrorBudget 只在错误比率严格大于5%且总请求率严格大于1/s连续2分钟后告警，标签只含稳定 severity=warning。保留给定 summary。独立生成完整 rollback.yaml（变更前 prometheus.yaml 与 rules.yaml 的内容映射），用于恢复原规则和配置；不得将错误规则称为修复结果。保留 rule-tests.yaml 的全部边界用例。

## 产物
提交 prometheus.yaml、rules.yaml、rollback.yaml；保留 rule-tests.yaml。

## 验收方法
网页执行 python3 checks/check.py，使用平台提供的promtool实际解析配置并执行可信规则测试。检查加权流量、低流量抑制、pending、恢复、Counter重置与短尖峰，以及稳定标签和可逆备份。验收读取可信内置fixtures，不接受修改学员侧测试文件来弱化预期；允许表达式空白、括号及通过全部行为测试的等价写法。平台缺promtool时明确报告能力缺失，不能退化为字符串比对。未访问实际目标，未投递告警。

## 原理复习
低请求量服务错误率100%时如何避免误解影响范围？

exercise.operation: 交付 prometheus.yaml 与 rules.yaml：保持生产目标和一分钟采集不变，接入 service-sli 规则组。先按 service 汇总各实例 Counter 的 rate[2m]，生成请求率、5xx错误率、加权错误比率三个记录规则；不要平均实例错误百分比。ServiceErrorBudget 只在错误比率严格大于5%且总请求率严格大于1/s连续2分钟后告警，标签只含稳定 severity=warning。保留给定 summary。独立生成完整 rollback.yaml（变更前 prometheus.yaml 与 rules.yaml 的内容映射），用于恢复原规则和配置；不得将错误规则称为修复结果。保留 rule-tests.yaml 的全部边界用例。
exercise.verification: 实际promtool check config及可信promtool test rules；配置身份/回滚约束检查；不启动服务。
capability_gap: 平台实验镜像必须提供promtool，否则明确不可验收；未实际抓取或投递告警。
failure_examples: 删除请求率门限会使 quiet 服务误报；对实例错误率求平均会误报 weighted；for=0m 会让短尖峰立即触发；回滚 rule_files 必须还原为空。
